personas.background: Has been trail running and hiking in the region for six years. Became the unofficial trip planner after he showed up with a laminated elevation map to the group's second outing. Methodical, respected for logistics, occasionally rigid about route selection. Close with Elena from a night hike they navigated together after a missed junction.

skills_list.skill: route planning and topographic map reading

food.value: brings only high-calorie trail bars — visibly sceptical of anyone who turns up with sandwiches on a long day

activities.value: prefers routes with a clear summit or end-point — resists loop trails that feel purposeless

social.value: dislikes last-minute route changes proposed in the group chat — wants plans confirmed 48 hours out

personas.background: Joined the group 18 months ago after a colleague recommended it. Quickly became known as the injury consultant — she does a quiet visual check of everyone's footwear at the trailhead. Has a relaxed persona but is fiercely competitive on timed segments. Closest to Marcus.

food.value: avoids processed energy gels — always brings real food (dates, cheese, rice cakes) and shares without being asked

activities.value: loves timed segments and quietly records her splits — gets annoyed if the group cuts a marked segment short

social.value: prefers post-hike meals at the pub over coffee shop debrief — says pubs have better stair access for tired legs

domain_specific.value: checks everyone's footwear at the trailhead and will suggest alternatives if she sees risks — rarely resisted

preference_history.old_value: happy to go wherever the group agrees, no strong view
preference_history.new_value: consistently advocates for the pub over coffee shops — becomes the de facto post-hike venue organiser

preference_history.old_value: participates in timed segments casually, not tracking results

speaking_quirks: uses 'form check' as a header before any technique note

personas.background: Has been with the group from the beginning — helped found it with Marcus after a shared Duke of Edinburgh alumni event. Knows local trails by memory. Talks a lot but nearly always usefully. Has a slight tension with Bridget, who joined from a rival hiking club and sometimes questions his route selections.

food.value: brings homemade energy balls and insists everyone tries one — offended if declined

activities.value: prefers routes with ecological or geographical points of interest — stops to explain formations without being asked

social.value: loves the pre-hike chat as much as the hike itself — arrives 30 minutes early to talk

domain_specific.value: dislikes using commercial hiking apps — prefers paper OS maps and will argue for them

preference_history.old_value: expects to co-plan all routes with Marcus, strong opinions about alternatives
preference_history.new_value: defers to Marcus on technical routes, takes lead on ecology-rich and scenic alternatives

uses 'back in the day' to reference a trail before a path was formalised

personas.background: Joined the group after a friend dropped out and gave her the slot. Initially the least experienced hiker but has progressed faster than expected. Works from home most days, so is often first to reply. Close with Nadia — they carpooled for the first few sessions and have stayed tight.

food.value: vegetarian — doesn't mention it but always asks 'is there a veggie option' at the post-hike pub

activities.value: initially avoided steep descents after her ankle injury; recently started volunteering for them to build confidence

social.value: prefers group chats to stay warm and social rather than purely logistical — posts reaction content to keep energy up

domain_specific.value: takes candid trail photos throughout and posts them to the group chat without tagging anyone — others have come to expect them

preference_history.old_value: avoids steep descents after the Ridgeback ankle incident, prefers gentler routes

personas.background: Found the group through a local outdoor notice board. Has a quiet but steady presence — never the loudest but always well-prepared. Carpooled with Priya early on and they became close. Has a dry sense of humour that only the regulars pick up on. Slightly reserved around newer members.

food.value: avoids caffeinated drinks on the day of a hike — always brings herbal tea in a thermos, occasionally shares without offering

activities.value: strongly prefers overnight hikes over day trips — finds day hikes feel incomplete

social.value: dislikes large-group photos at summits — steps to the edge or offers to take it instead

domain_specific.value: packs for every weather contingency — has bailed out at least two other group members with spare layers and a rain cover

preference_history.old_value: reserved around new joiners, waits for them to prove commitment before engaging
preference_history.new_value: actively introduces herself to new members and shares trailhead prep tips

preference_history.old_value: quietly interested in overnight hikes but doesn't push for them
preference_history.new_value: consistently raises overnight options when planning and shares kit lists unprompted

speaking_quirks: replies to long threads with a single sentence that cuts to the conclusion
uses 'weather window' as shorthand for any brief good-weather gap
follows a dry joke with nothing — no emoji, no elaboration, leaving it to land or not

personas.background: Former member of a rival hiking club who joined after a group merger fell apart. Brings strong organisational instincts but a slightly cliquey history that a few members remember. Has a low-grade tension with Tomás over route authority. Gets on well with Dmitri and Kwame, who don't care about the club politics.

food.value: strict about not eating at trail stops — only eats at the designated lunch point she builds into any route she plans

activities.value: prefers pre-planned routes with no spontaneous diversions — has left a group mid-hike once when a diversion added an unplanned two hours

social.value: dislikes shared accommodation for group overnight stays — prefers her own tent or separate room

preference_history.old_value: relates primarily to Dmitri and Kwame, keeps distance from founding members
preference_history.new_value: engages directly with Marcus on planning and defers to Elena on safety — old club identity less prominent

speaking_quirks: uses bullet-point format for any message with more than two items
references 'the old club' only when genuinely relevant, but it surfaces under pressure
ends cost-related messages with a running total in brackets

personas.occupation: Retired army officer, now a part-time outdoor education instructor
personas.background: The oldest active member of the group. Joined through Kwame, a former student of his. Brings an unhurried, unflappable energy that younger members find calming under pressure. Rarely initiates messages but when he speaks it lands. Dislikes drama and usually waits for a thread to settle before contributing.

food.value: eats whatever is in front of him without comment — has never expressed a food preference in the group chat

activities.value: strongly prefers longer slower days over fast-and-light approaches — says speed removes the point

social.value: dislikes group debrief circles — finds them performative; prefers one-on-one conversations on the walk back

domain_specific.value: won't carry a personal tracking device on leisure hikes — views them as a crutch; has agreed to carry a group PLB

preference_history.old_value: provides safety guidance only when asked — does not volunteer instruction
preference_history.new_value: proactively pairs with less experienced members on technical sections and offers instruction naturally
preference_history.trigger: watched Priya struggle on the first steep descent and quietly shadowed her — she thanked him at the bottom and he realised it was more useful than standing back

preference_history.old_value: participates in overnight trips but does not advocate for them
preference_history.new_value: actively supports Nadia's overnight proposals and contributes kit and safety planning

speaking_quirks: uses military time ('meet at 07:00') without irony
says 'noted' to acknowledge something without committing to a view
describes weather in operational terms ('visibility will be poor above 600m by 1400')

Enthusiastic, visibly excited by everything, a bit chaotic with logistics but great at keeping morale up on hard days. Close with Dmitri and increasingly close with Elena.

food.value: always brings too much food and distributes it liberally — hates hiking hungry and assumes everyone does

personas.background: The newest member of the group, joined partway through the first year. Was introduced by Elena through the hospital sports club. Works punishing hours but treats hiking as non-negotiable recovery time. Often joins late to planning threads and accepts whatever has been decided. Quietly capable on trail — stronger than her age and experience suggest.

skills_list.skill: emergency medicine and on-trail medical assessment
mental load management and decision fatigue coping

food.value: avoids eating anything sugary before long ascents — quietly declines Tomás's energy balls and substitutes with her own savoury snacks

activities.value: prefers technically demanding routes that require focus — says they're the only thing that actually switches her brain off

social.value: joins planning threads late and accepts the group decision without complaint — values not having to think

edges.history_summary: Navigated together through a missed junction on a night hike early in the group. Marcus's planning and Elena's calmness under pressure complemented each other. Mutual respect has grown into genuine friendship.

Co-founded the group together but have competing ideas about route authority. A car park argument before Session 5 led to an informal division of responsibilities. Respect each other's expertise but have to consciously avoid overlap.
Carpooled for the first three sessions and talked extensively en route. Have become the closest friendship pair in the group. Cover for each other on availability queries.
shared_events: planning the overnight Cairn Ridge trip together

edges.history_summary: Dmitri was Kwame's outdoor education instructor in his early twenties. Kwame brought him into the group. They have a warm, slightly asymmetric dynamic — Kwame still defers to Dmitri in the field.
Elena introduced Saoirse through the hospital sports club. Shares a clinical background and a relaxed trail manner. Elena checks in on Saoirse's work-life balance unprompted.

Bridget's origin in a rival hiking club and her habit of questioning Tomás's route selections has created persistent friction. Neither has addressed it directly. The rest of the group quietly notices.
shared_events: route dispute on the Moorland Traverse

edges.history_summary: Both are practical, non-dramatic, and results-oriented. Bonded over organising the Cairn Ridge overnight logistics together. Dmitri's steadiness and Bridget's precision work well.
shared_events: weather decision-making on a marginal day

edges.history_summary: Bridget finds Kwame chaotic but likeable. Kwame finds Bridget funny without trying to be. They have a jokey rapport around his perpetual lateness.
Both value precision and preparation. Have never socialised outside the group but consistently rely on each other for safety decisions on technical days.
Both are high-energy and competitive. Have run the same timed segments and compare results. Elena has unofficially adopted Kwame's scrambling enthusiasm.
Both are reserved, precise, and well-prepared. Have traded one-liners on the walk back that others didn't catch. Neither has sought a closer connection but neither has avoided it.
shared_events: Cairn Ridge overnight overnight tent proximity

edges.history_summary: Tomás has taken Priya under his wing for trail ecology and navigation basics. Priya finds his enthusiasm charming. He occasionally talks too much but she's learnt a lot.
Both joined later than the founding cohort and bonded over navigating an established group dynamic. Priya helped orient Saoirse in her first session.

Marcus appreciates Bridget's organisational contributions. Bridget respects Marcus's technical knowledge but was initially wary of the founding-member dynamic. Relationship has warmed since the Cairn Ridge overnight.
Have shared a trail for many sessions but have rarely spoken directly. Both are somewhat introverted in group settings and have not found a natural opening for more.
Both tend to form their main connection with specific people in the group rather than distributing social energy. Have been on the same hike many times but rarely walked together.
Kwame enjoys Tomás's trail stories and Tomás is charmed by Kwame's enthusiasm. Neither has pursued a closer connection but they reliably animate each other in group settings.

group_norms.norm_text: Confirm attendance by Thursday evening for any Saturday hike
Everyone carries a full personal first aid kit and a foil emergency blanket
No Strava or social media posts that reveal a route before the group has completed it
The group waits at every junction for all members before moving on
Post-hike social (pub or café) is optional but the group always offers a time and place
